history.sg_progress: The Administration will continue to encourage feedback from those vendors who were invited to submit offers but chose not to participate in the solicitation process. Should a viable and cost-friendly solution be identified, whether through Ariba E-tendering or an alternative feedback collection mechanism, a formal communication will be issued to procurement officers in the Procurement Division providing guidance on implementing the new approach. In addition, procurement officers will be instructed to include in all future submissions to the Headquarters Committee on Contracts and/or case presentations a dedicated section outlining the efforts made to solicit feedback from non-responding vendors.
